text.content:
• 1am: Telegram empty. Board dry (parked home-venue idea + 2 On Hold). npx next build clean, utils self-check clean.
• 💡 Built (Step 2c): "Plays when you do" — the recurring weekly availability grid (signup + Settings) was only shown on a player's own profile, never used for discovery. Now: Players list rows show a sky-blue calendar badge counting the weekly slots you + that player are both usually free (ranked list + Following tab); the profile Availability grid highlights shared cells in blue with a "You're both usually free in N slots" line. New sharedAvailabilitySlots() helper in utils.ts + self-check. No schema change. Skipped a filter/sort toggle (crowded 380px filter row) — badge carries it. Commit 9e00712, deployed green, bundle verified live. Full visual check pending an authed session (see Carry Forward).
• 5am (Step 2b audit): found + fixed a privacy gap in the 1am feature — the Players-list overlap badge showed "both free in N slots" for private accounts you don't follow, which the profile page itself hides (canSeeFullProfile). Now gated by the same rule (!isPrivate || following). Following tab was already correct. Build clean, all 16 self-check suites green, deployed green (c8db437). Live visual check still needs an authed session (auth-gated page). Also removed 4 stray _tmp_*.json dumps accidentally committed earlier + gitignored the pattern (18318e4).
• 9am (Step 2b audit): board still dry. Audited the reordered 4-step signup quiz — found a silent-failure bug: createUserRow() ignored its Supabase insert error, so a failed profile insert (username-race on the unique constraint, transient DB/RLS error) still reported signup success while wiping the player's quiz answers and leaving no users row — next load bounced them to a blank manual setup form. Fixed at root: createUserRow throws on error, completeProfile's catch surfaces a friendly message and keeps
